response.sql: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_rebate) AS average_rebate FROM fee_groups) SELECT g.orderslink, g.order_type, g.average_rebate, g.average_relative_gap, g.average_rebate - b.average_rebate AS rebate_excess FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.average_rebate > b.average_rebate ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero fee rate gives a NULL relative gap, which AVG excludes.
